value.text: {"claims":[{"quote":"On the call, management said volume orders for the CPO laser source from its \"largest customer\" had been pushed from FQ2 into \"the second half of calendar 2027,\" citing \"customer qualification timing and system-level thermal validation.\"","tickers":["NVDA"],"entities":["Lumivance Photonics"],"kind":"management_comment","metric":"CPO laser source volume order timing","period":"second half of calendar 2027","value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":false},{"quote":"In its previous 10-K, however, LMVN identified that customer as the supplier for a leading GPU vendor's photonic switch platform, and our channel work indicates that platform is Nvidia's Quantum-X/Spectrum-X Photonics family.","tickers":["NVDA"],"entities":["Lumivance Photonics"],"kind":"channel_check","metric":"identity of LMVN largest customer's platform","period":null,"value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":true},{"quote":"Nvidia has framed CPO switching as a multi-year attach opportunity, but its near-term revenue contribution is small, so we do not see a near-term effect on FQ3/FQ4 results.","tickers":["NVDA"],"entities":[],"kind":"opinion","metric":"near-term effect of CPO switching on results","period":"FQ3/FQ4","value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":false}]}
